## Verdict

PASS. No blocker or high-severity security finding remains in the pre-implementation architecture. Security R4 is closed without weakening the cancellation fence: MainActor now performs only pure ticket/envelope value work and immediate asynchronous enqueue; the dedicated control context is the only caller allowed to wait for the commit lock. The raw executor never waits on that context, and the exact lock-protected value record supplies a single linearization point for cancellation versus key-down. Required post-down heartbeat and cleanup-order selectors make the repair executable rather than aspirational.

## Security R4 closure

The former blocking path is removed. MainActor creates an opaque handle from a process-instance nonce plus checked never-reused ID, stores the exact frozen envelope, and enqueues admission without a lock, queue synchronization, raw reference, await, or callback gap (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:245-281`, `:293-316`). Close, Escape, lifecycle revocation, and task-cancellation handling mark local cancellation pending and enqueue the retained handle with immediate return; every commit-lock wait occurs only on the dedicated control context (`:336-372`, `:685-714`). MainActor retains the handle and noneditable authority until a matching terminal event proves destruction and retirement (`:332-334`, `:710-714`).

The architecture now includes the missing liveness oracle. A concrete post-down pause holds the commit lock while close/Escape runs through MainActor; repeated heartbeat ticks and UI rendering must continue while the control-plane cancellation command waits. Releasing the pause must still produce exactly one mandatory up, terminal submitted-unverified uncertainty, zero resend, and no Send re-exposure (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:716-728`, `:930-980`, `:1141-1143`). This directly falsifies the R4 reproduction rather than merely moving its lock call behind another MainActor wrapper.

## Queue, lock, and authority proof

- Ticket create/store/enqueue is linearized locally before any control or raw work. MainActor has one `admissionPending/currentHandle` fence, and the control store admits only one matching unexpired envelope. Start is not enqueued until a matching acceptance is applied and local cancellation is absent (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:277-334`). This prevents async admission from minting sibling permits or racing a second gesture.
- The control record contains the exact nonce/never-reused ID, immutable request, immutable absolute deadline, phase, and cancellation bit, but no raw AX, event, source, backend, closure, continuation, or target-registry reference (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:336-356`). The handle initializer is issuer-internal and overflow fails closed, so views and targets cannot forge authority (`:277-281`).
- Admission, start, and cancellation calls from MainActor enqueue directly onto one serial control context and preserve caller FIFO. Acceptance/start and cancellation-before-start are therefore ordered: a cancelled unclaimed record terminalizes with zero raw queue, registry, AX, construction, or post work; a late start fails its exact phase/cancellation check (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:311-330`, `:945-969`).
- The control context and raw executor never synchronously dispatch to or wait on each other. The raw executor may only claim/check/transition the shared value record under the commit lock; it validates the copied target ID against its own serial registry before any AX setter, cursor restore, event construction, or preparation, and cannot substitute or renew the descriptor/deadline (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:352-380`, `:490-548`).
- Cancellation and commit share one exact linearization point. Cancel-first sets the exact record bit and every subsequent checkpoint or final gate rejects down. Commit-first crosses down under the same lock, after which cancellation is advisory only and cannot suppress mandatory up. Enqueue time is deliberately not misreported as lock linearization (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:358-387`, `:549-573`).
- Control/raw FIFO cleanup cannot expose a receipt early. A claimed attempt destroys every post-capable event/source before nonblocking cleanup enqueue. Earlier control cancellation commands resolve before the later cleanup command; the control context then terminalizes and retires the exact record before asynchronously emitting terminal. The raw executor never waits for this process, and a retired handle returns `notCurrent` without affecting a later attempt (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:389-394`, `:565-583`).
- Post-boundary cleanup is equally one-shot: raw postflight destroys/releases the prepared pair, enqueues only a Sendable value, and the control context merges earlier advisory cancellation state before terminal retirement/event delivery. No raw capability or retry authority crosses either queue (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:570-589`, `:730-740`).

## Prior security boundary regression review

- Zero pre-confirmation output remains categorical. Fn, streaming, sealing, every edit, focus handling, provisional recovery, and lifecycle paths cannot post CGEvents, call AX setters, restore target focus/caret, activate, read/write/snapshot/restore pasteboard state, copy/paste, synthesize any signal, deliver, retry, retarget, or auto-confirm (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:40-63`, `:1023-1038`).
- Authority remains available only after same-generation action 2 plus recorder barrier and only from a real visible Send click or exact qualified preview-local Return/Enter. Current review/generation/revision, editable state, safe nonempty draft, 16,384 UTF-16-unit cap, destination generation, and one-active guards all precede envelope construction (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:51-60`, `:218-243`, `:283-291`). The independent recording and recognition topology remains protected (`:1161-1162`).
- Prepared output remains raw-executor-confined and binds the fixed target PID, exact frozen UTF-16 payload on down/up, modifier-free flags, one private source, exact FeishuSpeech tag, own source PID, and complete phase/payload/flags/tag/source-PID/target-PID readback before posting. This preserves surrogate and non-BMP content under the UTF-16 cap (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:396-410`).
- The first key-down attempt remains the irreversible boundary. Every pre-boundary failure is `notStarted`; after down, key-up is synchronous and mandatory, all outcomes remain submitted-unverified, target consumption is never claimed, and no ordinary Send/Return or retry authority returns (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:412-426`, `:565-589`, `:730-740`).
- Raw AX elements, target registry, raw CGEvents/source, prepared pair, epoch baseline, and posting backend remain confined to one raw serial executor. The separate control plane owns only Sendable value metadata/events and cannot receive a raw reference; MainActor waits on neither domain (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:142-207`, `:490-503`, `:692-698`). Every newly messaged AX object receives its own `min(500 ms, remaining budget)` timeout (`:202-207`, `:655-676`).
- One absolute monotonic deadline is computed once at gesture consumption, preserved byte/value-exact through control admission and raw claim, and spends control delay, raw queue wait, AX, monitor/baseline, modifier, preparation, gate admission, and the final under-lock check. No MainActor timeout or stale worker can re-enable while an old post capability remains (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:247-268`, `:318-334`, `:653-683`).
- The combined epoch still covers physical keyboard/mouse/modifier input, target activation/frontmost change, termination, process generation, observer loss, and both tap-disablement modes. Only exact tag plus own source PID is exempt; lifecycle signals are never exempt. Observer callbacks synchronously advance only the value primitive and transfer no raw event (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:596-623`).
- Target capture stays immutable and executor-owned. Exact-cursor restoration is post-confirmation only; application-bound fallback uses only the captured stable positive PID/identity/current responder while it remains frontmost and never activates, retargets, or selects an ambient PID (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:142-211`). The unavoidable WindowServer/PID observation micro-window remains honestly bounded as fixed-target terminal uncertainty with no resend (`:625-649`).
- The preview remains nonactivating with visible Send as the only focus-failure fallback. One local arbiter alone authorizes exact unmodified nonrepeating Return/keypad Enter in the exact key panel; Shift/IME, modified/repeated, Control+Return, out-of-preview Return, default-button behavior, and global monitors cannot construct intent (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:65-140`, `:742-787`).
- Clipboard/Cmd+V, copy/paste, target activation, ambient retargeting, automatic retry, global Return capture, and MainActor lock acquisition remain explicitly forbidden on the accepted path. Installed UAT retains the residual delayed-image/clipboard/character/Return check after application quit (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:1147-1148`, `:1161-1180`).
- The diagnostic RED order remains custody-safe: only a behavior-preserving seam may precede TDD RED; the failing oracle exercises the real rejected reentrant composition, and GREEN must use the concrete repaired epoch/control/executor/committer rather than a no-op closure (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:900-943`).
